caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a light brown color. The chair features a ladder-back design with four horizontal, curved slats attached between two vertical posts forming the backrest. The seat of the chair is woven, likely from a natural material such as straw or rush, and is colored in shades of yellow and light brown. The chair has four straight legs, with additional horizontal support bars connecting the legs on each side and across the front and back near the base. The drawing is rendered on a beige background with a slightly textured or aged appearance, and there are some brownish spots visible near the right side of the image.
title: Side Chair
